newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - New York City $200 mln GOs.
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - New York City $200 mln GOs.

text.p: To Be Dated Date of Delivery on or About June 10, 1997 SEALED PROPOSALS will be received for all of the Bonds on

at 10:00 A.M. (E.D.T.) by the Comptroller of the City at his offices, One Centre Street, 5th Floor, New York, New York; provided, however, that notice of a change in such time or date, or in other matters relating to the bonds, may be given no later than 1:00 P.M., on the day prior to the day originally scheduled for the receipt of such proposals by a supplemental notice via Munifacts.
All bids must be made on the Official Bid form and in conformity with its terms.
Bidders can obtain the preliminary Official Statement dated May 28, 1997 (including the Notice of Sale and Official Bid Form), by faxing a request to Global Financial Press at (212) 387-7217.
